term_source.integrity_rule: Before matching, SHA-256 of the referenced UTF-8 dictionary must equal term_source.sha256. A mismatch is a preflight failure; neither terms nor pair rules may be inferred, added, dropped, stemmed, or wildcard-expanded locally.

included_object_routes.parent_route: subcontributions[] within an event contribution export when present
included_object_routes.hard_failure_if: A nonempty source sub-contribution lacks a stable source identifier or canonical same-origin route, or cannot be mapped to its parent without cross-record text combination.

included_object_routes.parent_route: folders[].attachments[] at event and contribution/subcontribution scope in the event export

included_object_routes.discovery_route: GET https://indico.esa.int/event/{event_id}/timetable/; extract every public same-event href whose query is note={note_id}

structural_only_routes.rule: Use category 0 only to enumerate events. Do not use category title or description as a matching route or a candidate object.
Use only to reconcile event children and discover public event_note links. Do not use session/block text as a matching route or a candidate object.

excluded_external_routes.rule: Not part of the ESA Indico source universe.
Not part of the ESA Indico source universe; it is a formal-reference listing route.

excluded_external_routes.route_or_scope: ESA Archives Portal / SHIP and historical archive holdings
excluded_external_routes.rule: Not part of the ESA Indico source universe; it is a separately hosted historical/archive collection with its own access and rights conditions.

interface_classification.direct_boolean_prohibition: Do not execute any direct A1/A2/A3/B1/B2/BG1/BG2/BC1/BT2/V1/O1 translation against the search route. The observed AND/OR/NOT/parenthesis/symbol tests are not lossless, field syntax was not validated, wildcard-only search returns an explicit zero, and result totals can be -1.

universe_and_completion.source_universe_definition: The only acceptable final universe is the complete set of anonymous-public event records returned by a validated root-category enumeration, plus every public event, contribution, sub-contribution, attachment, and event_note child reachable through the routes in source_boundary. Private/protected objects are not in the public universe but must be counted as such in the receipt.

why_not_established.statement: Bounded root-category samples returned count equal to returned rows and stable repeated order, but exposed no pagenav and did not prove root recursion, interval coverage, absence of a response cap, or coverage of undated objects.

The root category sample included a category-5 event absent from category 6 and included long-running events that began before the requested range, so a category-6-only or start-date-only harvest is invalid.
No public documentation or exhaustive diagnostic proved that every public event exposes a complete anonymous timetable and that every public event_note link is present there.

hard_preflight_gates.requirement: Re-pilot a prospectively fixed root-category partition plan and prove category-0 recursive scope, date/overlap semantics, treatment of undated records, no hidden response cap, and count-to-row reconciliation for every partition.

Run two complete root enumerations using the same fixed partition plan; for every partition require exact ordered event-ID equality, equal count/row totals, no duplicate or missing event ID, and a stable combined event-ID ledger.

For every enumerated event, reconcile one anonymous event export and one anonymous timetable against the event ledger; validate exact contribution/subcontribution child ledgers and every public note link. The event-293 bounded example succeeded for 35 contribution friendly IDs but does not prove all events.

For every unprotected file attachment, complete same-origin retrieval and type-specific parsing. ZIP recursion, non-PDF parsers, link attachments, parse failures, and all source size/error behavior require a bounded validation before a successful final run.

prospective_only_enumeration_algorithm: Exit before any final retrieval while U1 through U4 are not verified.

After U1 is verified, issue each fixed root-category partition anonymously and retain the source count, returned event IDs in source order, route, request timestamp, response SHA-256, and all category IDs. A count/row mismatch, duplicate event ID within a partition, missing event ID, unparseable response, or non-200/anonymous access failure makes the source event failed with total=null.

Deduplicate only event identifiers across overlapping date partitions; retain every partition occurrence and its source order. Do not rely on an event start date alone because the observed endpoint returned overlapping long-running events.

For each unique event ID, fetch the event export with detail=contributions and the event timetable. Reconcile export contribution friendly IDs to timetable contribution friendly IDs when the event exposes both; any unexplained mismatch is a source-event failure.

Extract every same-event public note query link from the timetable, fetch each selected-note route, and retain note objects independently. A note route that redirects to login, leaves indico.esa.int, returns inaccessible content, or cannot be parsed is a source-event failure.

Enumerate every event-level and child-level attachment from the export before matching. No final candidate set may be created unless every U1-U4 condition and every object-level reconciliation succeeds twice.

zero_and_failure_rules.explicit_zero: Valid only when a requested, fully validated source route returns an explicit zero/count=0 with a parsed response and complete route coverage.
zero_and_failure_rules.null_total: Mandatory for access, transport, parse, identity, count, order, root-scope, child-reconciliation, attachment, or completeness failure.
zero_and_failure_rules.partial_prefix: Never imported, screened, or treated as a candidate set.

object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.event_id: event:{event_export.id}; require same-origin canonical event URL /event/{id}/.
object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.contribution_id: contribution:{event_export.id}:{contribution.db_id}; require canonical URL /event/{event_id}/contributions/{db_id}/. Do not use friendly_id/display id alone.
object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.subcontribution_id: subcontribution:{event_id}:{parent_db_id}:{subcontribution source id}; use canonical same-origin URL as a second identity witness. A missing component is fatal.
object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.attachment_id: attachment:{event_id}:{folder_id}:{attachment.id}; retain normalized same-origin download_url as a second identity witness. If the source repeats an attachment id under a different parent, retain both object instances and record checksum/content-hash overlap separately.
object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.event_note_id: event_note:{event_id}:{note_id}; use the source timetable note query and resolved same-origin route as identity witnesses. Do not identify a note by title or text.
object_identity_and_duplicate_policy.route_instance_id: {object_id}#{route_name}; metadata and content routes for one object are distinct matching instances.
deduplication: Do not deduplicate during source traversal or across partitions until every receipt has passed validation.
Within an object type, duplicate canonical identity is a failure unless it is an explicitly retained duplicate partition occurrence.
Across object types or parent/child relationships, preserve all route instances. Content-hash equality is overlap metadata only, not permission to merge records or combine terms.

matching_routes.text_scope: The two listed fields of one event only. Insert a field sentinel between fields; phrase matching may not cross it.

fields_in_order: note.html when it belongs to the contribution
matching_routes.text_scope: The listed fields of one contribution only. Insert a field sentinel between fields; phrase matching may not cross it.

fields_in_order: note.html when it belongs to the sub-contribution
matching_routes.text_scope: The listed fields of one sub-contribution only. Insert a field sentinel between fields; phrase matching may not cross it.
The listed fields of one attachment only. Parent event/contribution titles, folder titles, uploader data, and external-link target text are excluded.
One successfully retrieved, same-origin public file attachment only. Metadata text and attachment content are separate routes and cannot satisfy a compound rule together.

fields_in_order: selected public note title when exposed
matching_routes.text_scope: One selected note route only. Parent event/session/contribution text may not satisfy a rule with note text.

route_operand_scope.rule: For an ordinary Boolean rule, each primitive concept may be witnessed in any listed atomic field of one route_instance_id. A phrase or explicit pair must remain within one atomic field and cannot cross its field sentinel. No operand may use text from another route_instance_id.

normalization.input: Decode response bytes using declared charset; if absent, UTF-8. Decode HTML entities and remove markup while retaining visible text. Preserve original bytes, field value hash, and normalized text hash outside Git.
unicode: Apply Unicode NFKC, then Unicode casefold.
Map U+00AD and U+2010 through U+2015 and U+2212 to ASCII hyphen-minus.
Map every Unicode whitespace code point to one ASCII space and collapse adjacent spaces.
Do not strip letters, numbers, or diacritics beyond NFKC/casefold.
normalization.tokenization: Split normalized text at every run of characters other than Unicode letters or numbers. A hyphen and whitespace are separators. Retain field sentinels as hard boundaries.
normalization.phrase_rule: A finite phrase matches only an adjacent sequence of normalized tokens in one atomic field; it may not bridge a sentinel, route, record, object, or document boundary.
normalization.acronym_rule: EPS, PCDU, PMAD, MBSE, SysML, MIL, SIL, PIL, and HIL are token-equality matches after casefolding. Substring matching is forbidden.
normalization.hyphen_rule: Hyphenated and spaced spellings can match only when their finite dictionary aliases normalize to the same token sequence; a one-token spelling such as cubesat remains distinct from the two-token alias cube sat unless both are listed in the dictionary.

source_search_behavior.rule: Do not adopt the source search engine's case, quote, hyphen, or wildcard behavior. Bounded diagnostics showed case-equivalent first pages for MBSE/CubeSat, materially different cube-sat versus cube sat first pages, and only bounded first-page equality for nanosat and nanosat*.

normalization.wildcards: No wildcard syntax is accepted by the local matcher. Every finite dictionary term is expanded exactly as listed. A changed dictionary or an attempted wildcard is a preflight failure.

concept_evaluation.term_dereference: Resolve each term list and pair rule exactly from term_source.required_json_pointers after the integrity check.
concept_evaluation.explicit_pair_rule: For each dictionary pair_rule or T2 pair, match a left and right finite phrase in either order in the same atomic field, with zero through three intervening normalized tokens and no sentence terminator (. ! ? ;), field sentinel, route, or record boundary. Record both matched token spans and the intervening-token count.
concept_evaluation.independent_R_rule: Evaluate R after G_model, G_structure, C1, and T2 spans are recorded. An architecture token span used to establish an artifact phrase or an explicit pair cannot also establish R. Another non-overlapping R span in the same route may establish R.
concept_evaluation.witness_rule: Every true concept must retain route_instance_id, source field, normalized term or left/right pair, token spans, and normalizer version. A Boolean result without witnesses is a failure.

candidate_logic.candidate_unit: A route_instance_id, not a scientific study, report, screened record, or imported candidate.

boolean_rules.V1_sensitivity_tag: P AND E_probe AND M_probe AND V1
boolean_rules.O1_sensitivity_tag: P AND E_probe AND M_probe AND O1

candidate_logic.candidate_union: core_B_candidate OR BG1_expansion OR BG2_expansion OR BC1_expansion
candidate_logic.not_a_local_candidate_rule: T2, R, V1, and O1 are tags only. In particular, do not create a local BT2 expansion candidate; preserve T2 independently as the protocol's local-method minimum requires.
no_cross_combination: All operands of one Boolean rule must be witnessed in the same route_instance_id.
Do not combine terms across event, contribution, sub-contribution, attachment, note, category, session, metadata, or attachment-content routes.
Do not combine terms across parent/child objects, duplicate copies, partitions, source pages, or attachments inside an archive.
Archive members are separate attachment_content route instances with the outer attachment as provenance only.
invariants: Every candidate has at least one candidate reason and a witness for each operand in that reason.
Every candidate/tag row preserves all true reasons and tags; no reason is overwritten by deduplication.
A lexical match never establishes eligibility, relevance, publication type, language, report family, or screening decision.

overlap_accounting.route_level: Count each unique route_instance_id by the complete bit vector [core_B_candidate, stream_A_tag, BG1_expansion, BG2_expansion, BC1_expansion, R_independent_tag, T2_independent_tag, V1_sensitivity_tag, O1_sensitivity_tag].
overlap_accounting.object_level: After route-level validation, OR tags/reasons across route instances sharing an object identity, retain per-route witnesses, and report route-to-object collapse counts.
overlap_accounting.source_level: Report unique object identities, event/contribution/sub-contribution/attachment/note type counts, parent-child overlaps, candidate-reason intersections, stream-A/core-B intersections, expansion intersections, sensitivity tags, and no-candidate objects.

date_and_language.precondition: Do not execute a final run before task P-001 supplies the common evidence cutoff.
date_and_language.window_rule: Preserve all source dates and their field provenance. Apply an inclusive local evidence-window exclusion only to an object with a non-proxy event/contribution date known before 2011-01-01 or after the approved cutoff. A missing date, a material/note modification timestamp alone, or a conflicting parent/object date is unresolved and retained for later screening/date assessment; it is never silently excluded.
date_and_language.language_rule: Do not apply a native or inferred English filter. Preserve a source language field when present; otherwise record language=unknown and defer the English full-report criterion to screening.
date_and_language.observed_limit: The tested event export exposed language=null and the tested search adapter labels attachment modified year as a proxy rather than a publication date.

materials_and_access.public_file_retrieval: Fetch only an unprotected, same-origin https://indico.esa.int attachment download_url anonymously. Allow redirects only when the effective URL remains the same origin and contains no sensitive query context. Do not authenticate, send cookies, or follow an external target.
public_file_parse_plan: Record HTTP status, response content type, byte count, source checksum when supplied, downloaded SHA-256, and parser name/version/exit status outside Git.

For a PDF magic signature (%PDF-), run pdftotext with UTF-8 output and require exit status 0 plus nonempty decoded text or an explicit zero-text PDF outcome. The PDF path is a successful parser route only when those checks pass.
For text/plain, text/markdown, or text/html, decode and normalize visible text deterministically.
For ZIP magic (PK), list every member, reject unsafe paths/encryption/recursive archive loops, create an independent content route per member, and apply the same parser decision recursively.

For any remaining MIME/magic type, a parser must be prospectively validated before final execution. Otherwise classify it as unsupported_parse_type and fail the whole local event; do not treat it as no match.
materials_and_access.link_attachment_rule: For attachment type=link, match only the Indico-held attachment metadata route. A cross-origin target is not fetched or combined with Indico metadata; record it as an external-target source-boundary limitation for human review.
materials_and_access.protected_or_inaccessible_rule: A folder or attachment explicitly marked protected is outside the anonymous-public material universe; retain its count and protection flag, do not attempt login, and do not call it a zero. An object advertised unprotected that returns 401/403/418, login HTML, an invalid response, a missing body, checksum mismatch, parser failure, or storage failure is a coverage failure: total=null and no partial import.
materials_and_access.rate_limit_rule: Use one request at a time and at least 0.5 seconds between requests. On 408/425/429/500/502/503/504, honor Retry-After up to 60 seconds when supplied; otherwise wait 1, 2, then 4 seconds. A fourth failure, unexpected redirect, or absent rate-limit recovery evidence fails the source event. The actual server ceiling is untested.
observed_examples: One public PDF was retrieved anonymously with HTTP 200 and parsed by pdfinfo/pdftotext; no persistent PDF was retained.
A public ZIP rejected HEAD with 400 but accepted a 1024-byte GET range with HTTP 206; full archive traversal is not yet validated.
Protected folders appeared in a public category export, with no public attachment rows.

final_run_block.rule: This draft must stop before final local harvesting, candidate creation, screening, import, PRISMA accounting, or any write under searches/final-events. The only allowed current disposition is a diagnostic failure/revision record until every hard preflight gate is verified and a supervisor accepts the packet.
